data.summary: The models directory contains data transformation models, source definitions, and semantic layer configurations (such as MetricFlow time spine and semantic YAML files) forming the analytics engineering layer.

file_insights.name: _sources.yml
file_insights.summary: Defines source database and schema configuration for data warehouse tables.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines YAML version 2 source configuration for a published database using Iceberg schema dwh_spark with the fact_orders table.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the source database and schema configuration for Iceberg and Spark tables, specifically pointing to the fact_orders table.

file_insights.name: metricflow_time_spine.sql
file_insights.summary: SQL model generating a daily calendar time spine for MetricFlow semantic layer.
file_insights.source_summary: SQL query that uses unnest and sequence to generate dates from 2024-01-01 to 2028-12-31 as date_day.
file_insights.detailed_description: Generates a time spine table containing one row per calendar day from 2024 to 2028, which is required by MetricFlow for handling days with no data and ratio metrics.

file_insights.name: orders_semantic.sql
file_insights.summary: SQL model transforming order items data as a contract between warehouse and semantic layer.
file_insights.source_summary: SQL query selecting specific columns for order items and computing localized dates based on order timestamps.
file_insights.detailed_description: Acts as the contract between the warehouse and the semantic layer, defining order items with PII stripped out and timezone conversions handled for Taipei and UTC timezones.
responsibilities: Extract order item data without PII
Compute Taipei and UTC order dates at query time

file_insights.name: semantic.yml
file_insights.summary: YAML configuration file defining semantic models and metrics mapping for the semantic layer.
file_insights.source_summary: YAML configuration file defining the orders_semantic model properties, semantic_model settings, and column entities for MetricFlow.
file_insights.detailed_description: Configures the semantic model for order items, specifying entities, columns, aggregation time dimensions, and ownership for MetricFlow.
responsibilities: Map primary and foreign entities for order items
